**`dev → main` release PR — v0.51.0.** Bundles 17 commit(s) since origin/main.

## Highlights

- **A pm session no longer wedges on roundtable replay.** The replay is bounded, advances its watermark over what it consumed, and a full page no longer jumps the watermark (#880, #881, #888).
- **New config key `identity_hook.enforce`** in `coordination.config.json` (#866). Default `false`, so nothing changes until you set it. At `true`, the pre-commit identity hook refuses a per-command `git -c user.*` override.
- **Sprint lanes: a lane's `board` may now be a list of board ids** — membership is the union (#887). A lane may declare a `label`, shown as a chip on the burn-down page (#877).
- **Two new commands on PATH after `/coord:update` area 3:** `coord-hygiene` (#875) classifies worktrees, branches and caches by observable state and removes only the merged-and-clean ones, report-only on anything else; `coord-review` (#882, #862) runs a self-hosted adversarial review the author cannot touch, with the mechanical review planes computed into one digest.
- **Kanban reads are no longer silently truncated at page 1** (#884). `gh api --paginate` stops early on a cursor-shaped `Link`; the walk now pages by explicit `page=N`.
- **The BEHIND merge refusal reads the base branch's live `strict` setting from both protection surfaces and fails closed when it cannot read it** (#872).
